content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your current signals support one quality day: Fitness 55, Fatigue 48, Form +7, with stable resting HR/HRV and 7.5-hour sleep. Your recent two rides totaled 3.5 hours and 140 Load, so I’d keep the weekend productive but controlled.

**Saturday, July 11 — Sweet spot, ~65min**  
Warmup: 15min building from 50–70% FTP  
Main: 3×10min at 88–92% FTP, 4min easy at 50–55% between  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: Intensity 0.75–0.80, Load 55–65  
Why: Adds focused aerobic/FTP work without a large fatigue spike.

**Sunday, July 12 — Endurance, 90min**  
Warmup: 10min at 50–60% FTP  
Main: 70min at 60–72% FTP, conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated: Intensity 0.65–0.70, Load 65–75  
Why: Builds endurance and consolidates Saturday’s work without another hard stimulus.

If Saturday morning brings poor sleep, unusually heavy legs, or resting HR about 5 bpm above normal, replace the sweet-spot work with easy Z1–Z2 riding. Estimated weekend Load: **120–140**.
